text:
Evelyn (CS): short capture from today's trial check-ins. recurring asks: 1) a one-click CSV export of feature asks for PMs, 2) a billing-delta heatmap to surface sudden token spend by route, and 3) an embeddings-freshness webhook so customers can reindex after model swaps.
Ravi (AM): two accounts in trials mentioned they'll delay rollout if invoices spike again. one renewal cliff in ~21 days. this feels priority.
Omar (PM): thanks. my proposal: quick wins = CSV export + a lightweight heatmap banner (7-day window). webhook + full dashboard are medium-term.
Tasha (SE): dev estimates: CSV export ~1 day (export job + UI link), heatmap banner (frontend + hourly aggregation) ~5 days, webhook + safe reindex flow ~1.5w (safety + rate-limits). we'll need telemetry fields: `route.token.delta` and `embed.version_hash`.
Evelyn (CS): sample verbatim quote to paste in tickets: "We saw our support bot eat 40% of our monthly tokens overnight. We have zero visibility until the bill."
Ravi (AM): tagging accounts: NOVA-321, STRATA-88. adding renewal flags to the ticket if possible.
ops-bot: created ticket CS-91230 "Feature-asks CSV export" and CS-91231 "Billing delta heatmap banner". CS-91231 assigned -> @Tasha.
Omar (PM): I'll bump CS-91230 into next sprint for the fast win and CS-91231 into the sprint after the hotfix lane. webhook ticket to follow once we confirm embed infra constraints.
Tasha (SE): will scope telemetry changes. quick ask: can CS provide 6 sample rows (account, tier, renewal_date, ask, quote, impact) so I can validate CSV schema?
Evelyn (CS): posting sample rows: "Acme,Enterprise,2024-10-02,CSV export,\"We need a list to share with product\",4"; "Nova,Mid,2024-06-18,Billing heatmap,\"We had a 3x spike overnight\",5"; "Zephyr,SMB,2024-11-01,Reindex webhook,\"Search degraded after model change\",3".
Ravi (AM): please surface anything with impact>=4 and renewal<=30d as high. I'll prioritize outreach if flagged.
Omar (PM): agree. CS, please send the scored bundle by EOD. we'll include exact acceptance criteria: CSV header names, heatmap tooltip thresholds, and webhook auth expectations.
Evelyn (CS): will do. also recommend adding a small in-Console nudge for new routes in their first 7 days to reduce surprise spikes (copy from enablement).
Tasha (SE): that nudge is low lift; can ship as an experiment behind a flag. I'll add it to CS-91231.
Evelyn (CS): thanks team 44d will attach full raw list + quotes to CS-91230 later today.
Omar (PM): perfect. once tickets have scope, let's schedule a 20m handoff with AMs for the high-risk accounts.
